text:
jess: Rolling up newton-14b (int4) to canary and hit OOM spikes + latency tail. Canary traffic ~10%.
omar: ugh, saw that. can you paste the OOM snippet? is it max_new_tokens blowup or allocator fragmentation?
leah: log snippet from canary host:
```
[2024-05-12T14:12:03Z] OOM: allocation failed during KV cache grow (requested 24MB)
[2024-05-12T14:12:03Z] slab_jitter: free_slots=1200, fragmented=42%, compaction_attempts=0
[2024-05-12T14:12:03Z] trace: token-gen bulk=512 max_new_tokens=256 batch=4
```
ryan: that trace looks like max_new_tokens=256 + batch=4 -> kv growth. int4 reduces headroom so fragmentation surfaces faster.
jess: we tried lowering max_new_tokens to 64 in a local smoke test; memory pressure dropped but long-form QA quality dropped noticeably.
ciara: can we run a controlled eval? please run eval-suite --profile longreads --variant int4 --baseline fp16 and post metrics to the thread.
ryan: also try changing batching.window_ms to 15 and batch_max_tokens to 128 so we avoid >4 concurrent writers to KV. microbatching helps for latency too.
leah: rolling canary patch now with configs: max_new_tokens=64, batching.window_ms=20, batch_max_tokens=128, kv_prefetch=false, slot_compactor=aggressive. adding eval hook.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: newton-14b-int4-canary @ hosts: canary-3a (id c-2379). CI job: canary-eval/1715554322
omar: FYI we previously saw slab-jitter go away when compactor was aggressive, but that can increase CPU. watch tail-CPU.
jess: good call. ciara — add quality gate: ROUGE-L drop <=1.5% vs fp16 baseline; if fail, auto-fallback to fp16 variant.
ciara: added. eval job queued: <http://ci.internal.redwood/evals/1715554322>
ryan: quick note: if we still see fragmentation, consider soft-evict policy for prefix cache: eviction threshold 0.6 and try adaptive-kv-trim on heavy sessions.
leah: canary reports in ~10m. i'll post metrics snapshot (latency p95, mem RSS, loss of ROUGE) once done.
jess: thanks team. if this passes, plan is to keep int4 by default but set max_new_tokens default to 64 for newton-14b and add per-route override for longdocs.
omar: also add an operator note in runbook about incrementally increasing slot_compactor to handle fragmentation during peak warmups.
ryan: noted. I'll run a synthetic with long prompt to validate no slowgen OOMs.
jess: awesome. :thumbsup:
